correctness.rationale: Exact calculations of the coverage masks O,R,P,Q are justified by unique long zero gap. Every circular factor belongs to one of four exhaustive cases: all zeros, contains 10^q, contains 0^q1, or has a contiguous interval of h equally spaced ones with short zero margins. This proves four-mask dominance for all factors and all parameters. Disjoint O,R force two distinct markers; explicit P,Q intersections classify all two-position choices and yield exact enumeration. Literal independent exhaustive verification covers 252 parameter triples, every factor and every pair. Finite tests are corroboration only; no unproved extension.

value.rationale: A natural one-exceptional-gap perturbation of periodic binary necklaces exhibits a complete infinite three-parameter minimum circular attractor classification. The four-factor basis reduces universal factor coverage to a constant number of tests for arbitrary marker sets; optimal pair multiplicity undergoes a sharp s=q+1 crossover for m>=3. These are structural and useful invariants motivated by current complete-attractor-enumeration literature, not a finite unmotivated table or a reparametrization of prior adjacent-position existence.
